title: LowLifeOptimizations
description: This Project Adds Stability and usability for mods that haven't played nice together On From The Fog SMP!
body:
This Pack is made for the Players of FTF SMP
It Includes Multiple Mods such as 

Figura, Sodium, Iris, Sodium Extra, and Reese's Sodium Options

The struggles of using 1.21.3 for FTF SMP and seeing toolbox items not working due to the change of how textures work are annoying, so for the last few months i have worked on perfecting this, optimizing it, adding mods and tweaking it so it doesn't crash on death or any other wacky silly things!

Please Enjoy


**_Thank You Bret, Mia and All of From The Fog for having me as Staff, and a Player_**



- TheEeveeGamer for respective Resource Packs
